AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Lenslate translates text between English (en), French (fr), Spanish (es), German (de) and Japanese (ja). Operational Patterns: - Call 'translateText' directly; no setup or authentication call is required. - Pass an empty string for 'fromLanguage' / 'toLanguage' to use the language pair the user selected in the app. Constraints: - Language codes must be one of: en, fr, es, de, ja. - The on-device engine may need to download a model on first use, which requires a network connection.
